Wholesale Corkscrews, Electric Wine Openers and Dispensers

Manual openers, wing corkscrews, air-pump openers, USB rechargeable openers, aerating dispensers and kits.

Request corkscrews & wine openers pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Rechargeable wine tools carry the strongest margin in the catalogue and the least tariff exposure, because they classify as electrical goods rather than plastic tableware. This range spans simple ABS foil cutters and air-pump openers up to aluminium-alloy rechargeable openers, aerating dispensers and five- to six-piece gift kits that sell as boxed sets. All electric units ship without batteries for ocean freight and can be configured with USB-C charging, gift boxes and your client's logo.

ABS, aluminium alloy, stainless steel, zinc alloy

Corkscrews &amp; Wine Openers — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Corkscrews & Wine Openers range include?

This range holds 19 items, specified in ABS, aluminium alloy, stainless steel and zinc alloy. Orders come most often from retail and e-commerce brands, promotional distributors and gift and corporate programmes. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

Which corkscrews & wine openers can be branded?

Branding is evaluated against the specific opener, stopper, preserver or aerator SKU. The feasible logo method depends on the material, logo area, artwork, quantity and required packaging.

Logo decoration guide

Can corkscrews & wine openers be packed into a custom gift set?

Yes, subject to confirmation of each item, the insert layout, outer box, logo treatment, quantity and shipping protection. Submit the full set composition rather than requesting a quotation for individual items only.

Barware gift sets

How do I compare corkscrews & wine openers products?

Compare the stated components, compatible bottle format, intended use, care instructions and verified performance documentation. We do not publish preservation claims that are not supported by the selected SKU records.

Wine stoppers and pourers

Are the electric openers rechargeable or battery operated?

Both configurations exist in the range. The power source, charging method, plug standard and set contents are stated on the selected SKU page and confirmed in the quotation, because they change the price and the shipping documentation.
